changelog: v0.6.10 TEST BUILD: Feel wave — every gun has weight now. Heavier gun = slower move/accel and a literally wider hitbox (LMG +25% radius). Viewmodel runs on springs: reloads are choreographed, the gun dips when you land, recoil settles with a spring overshoot, sprint carries a lowered ready pose. Swap P9 <-> LMG in TDM and report how it feels.
